# slack_app (Data Source)

Export an existing Slack App manifest. This API does not return app credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "slack_app" "existing" {
  id = "A0123456789"
}

output "app_manifest" {
  value = jsondecode(data.slack_app.existing.manifest)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Slack App ID to export.

### Read-Only

- `manifest` (String) Complete JSON manifest exported by Slack. Decode using jsondecode.
